[PROMPT TYPE]
MiniMax H3 image-to-video. Image1 is the first frame and the sole identity/scene reference. Single continuous 10-second one-take shot, no cuts, cinematic live-action period-drama realism.

[REFERENCE USE]
Image1: first frame and reference for the empress — exact face, red-lip makeup, updo with golden phoenix headdress and dangling ornaments, black gown with golden bamboo-leaf embroidery — and for the hall: golden throne, black marble pillars, gilded lattice screens, lit candelabras.

[IDENTITY AND CONTINUITY LOCKS]
The woman keeps Image1's exact face, makeup, hairstyle, headdress and gown in every frame; the hall, throne, pillars and candle placement identical to Image1 throughout; no new people or props.

[SCENE]
The same throne hall as Image1: she begins seated on the golden throne at center, then rises and walks toward the camera down the throne platform, ending close to the lens with the dark hall and candle bokeh behind her.

[SHOT TIMELINE]
0.0–2.5 seconds — Hold Image1's low-angle framing; she sits in commanding stillness, chin lifted, then slowly raises her gaze into the lens; candle flames flicker softly; the camera begins an almost invisible dolly-in.
2.5–6.0 seconds — She presses the armrests and rises in one slow unhurried motion; the black gown with golden bamboo embroidery cascades as the camera tilts up; she steps down from the platform and takes two slow measured steps toward the camera, heels tapping stone, the framing tightening from full shot to medium as she approaches.
6.0–10.0 seconds — She stops close to the lens, settling into a tight close-up; her head turns a few slow degrees into a sidelong glance, eyelids narrowing a fraction, ornaments swaying almost imperceptibly; the gaze slides back to the lens, chin rises a fraction; hold the quiet menace to the end.

[CAMERA]
One unbroken camera move: ultra-slow dolly-in, tilt-up as she rises, then hold position while she walks into the close-up; focus pulls smoothly from full-shot depth to locked-on-eyes close-up; no cuts, no whip pans, no shake; pillar verticals stay straight.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Warm candlelight key with deep shadow falloff, golden highlights on the embroidery and headdress, low-key chiaroscuro; clean transparent image, filmic highlight rolloff, Arri Alexa-like color science, fine subtle film grain; live-action realistic period-drama look — not anime, not 3D, not CG.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
One long slow silk rustle as she rises, two soft heel taps on stone as she steps down, a slow breath at the close-up, faint candle-flame crackle, deep quiet hall room-tone; no music, no dialogue, no voice-over.

[CONTINUITY]
Face, makeup, hairstyle, headdress, gown and hall identical to Image1 in every frame; the approach is straight and centered so framing tightens evenly; motion stays slow and weighted throughout.

[NEGATIVES]
No cuts or jump-cuts in framing, no face morphing or identity drift, no costume or jewelry changes, no extra people, no jumping or floaty rise, no sliding feet, no gown clipping through the throne or steps, no sudden head turns, no speaking or lip movement, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no narration, no background music, no anime / 3D / CG look, no flickering set pieces, no warped throne or pillars, no deformed hands, no oversaturation, no watermark, no logo.
